newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline weaker but fails to catch NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline weaker but fails to catch NYMEX.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were weaker on Monday following large losses on NYMEX futures but dealers said prices in Europe had failed to fall as far as in the U.S. and this meant arbitrage opportunities were unworkable to the tune of around $10 a tonne.
Eurograde barges changed hands at between $188 and $192 a tonne fob ARA.
"These are some quite strong numbers considering the screen," one refinery-based player said. He assessed fob buying interest for Eurograde from the U.S. at around $177/$178.
Regular barges were traded at $183.50 and $183 a tonne.

A refiner in ARA sold a Eurograde cargo on Monday but further details were confidential, and the same refiner covered an unleaded 95 RON gasoline requirement in the Med, too, at a confidential quotes-related price.
